title: Arbitration and Conciliation Act s. 30 — Statutory provision (ACA s. 30)

content.overview: Section 30 permits the tribunal to encourage settlement at any stage. With party agreement, mediation, conciliation or other procedures may be used during the arbitration. A settlement may be recorded as an arbitral award on agreed terms when the statutory requirements are met.

content.study:
Section 30 — Settlement

Section 30 permits the tribunal to encourage settlement at any stage. With party agreement, mediation, conciliation or other procedures may be used during the arbitration. A settlement may be recorded as an arbitral award on agreed terms when the statutory requirements are met.

Apply the provision by identifying operative conditions, exceptions, procedural stage and connected provisions. Do not substitute generic arbitration practice for the statutory rule.
